_about: Who made the models the art is rendered from. scripts/export_assets.py adds the credit of every piece of junk it packs (props.json: credit) and writes the add-on's static/derby_credits.json (the Credits card at the bottom of the Derby tab) and static/CREDITS.md. licence_url is filled in for CC licences.
